description: 自來水管承裝商有效家數統計 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 「自來水管承裝商」係指承攬裝修自來水導水、送水、配水管線及自來水用戶用水設備工程業務之公司或商號，須向所在地之主管機關進行「營業許可」申請後始得營業，分為甲、乙、丙三等，甲等為資本額新臺幣一百萬元以上，聘僱有專任技術員一人及專任技工三人以上者，得承辦第二條所列之各項工程、乙等為資本額新臺幣五十萬元以上，聘僱有專任技工二人以上者，得承辦新臺... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
